cues.en: Hi, everybody.
cues.zh: 大家好，

cues.en: And let's go ahead and continue with another hosted tool.
cues.zh: 繼續介紹另一種託管工具，

cues.en: We've seen already Code Interpreter.
cues.zh: 前面已看過 Code Interpreter，

cues.en: Let's go ahead and take a look at Web Search, which is actually the Bing grounding search from Microsoft.
cues.zh: 現在看看 Web Search，實際上是微軟的 Bing Grounding 搜尋，

cues.en: Let's see how Web Search works as a tool as well.
cues.zh: 看看如何把網路搜尋當作工具使用。

cues.en: All right. Here we are.
cues.zh: 好，來到這裡，

cues.en: I created the project already called Web Search Demo.
cues.zh: 專案已建立好，叫 Web Search Demo，

cues.en: And in here in the project, let me go ahead and add all the NuGet packages.
cues.zh: 在專案加入所有 NuGet 套件，

cues.en: Again, it's the Agent Framework 1.1 with all the other suspects that we have been used to for over 15 different demos so far.
cues.zh: 一樣是 Agent Framework 1.1，以及前面十五個範例已經熟悉的其他套件。

cues.en: All right. Let me go ahead and save all of this.
cues.zh: 先儲存所有內容，

cues.en: There's one more thing before I forget.
cues.zh: 還有一件事，趁還沒忘記，

cues.en: I need to bring in the secrets as well.
cues.zh: 需要加入秘密設定，

cues.en: So let's cheat and get that from the previous project.
cues.zh: 從前一個專案借用，

cues.en: I'm going to take this line from the user secret ID, and I'm going to be placing it in the Web Search after nullable here as well.
cues.zh: 複製 UserSecretsId 這一行，貼到 Web Search 的 Nullable 後面，

cues.en: All right. Let me just make it look nice.
cues.zh: 稍微整理格式，

cues.en: Control S, and we're done with the project.
cues.zh: Ctrl+S，專案設定完成。

cues.en: All right. Now we're going to go to the program.cs.
cues.zh: 接著到 Program.cs，

cues.en: We're going to delete all that code that got generated for us automatically.
cues.zh: 把自動產生的程式碼全部刪掉，

cues.en: And what I'm interested in doing now is to bring in the code and explain to you what's going on there. All right.
cues.zh: 貼入範例程式，說明裡面做什麼。

cues.en: The same thing like every time.
cues.zh: 和每次一樣，

cues.en: We're going to build the user secrets.
cues.zh: 建立使用者秘密的組態，

cues.en: We're going to get the endpoint and the key.
cues.zh: 取得端點和金鑰，

cues.en: We're going to create an instance for the Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 建立 Azure OpenAI 的執行個體。

cues.en: And again, we're not going to do like usual, which is the client.getChatClient.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，不使用平常的 client.GetChatClient，

cues.en: That doesn't work with the hosted tools coming in from OpenAI.
cues.zh: 它不能搭配 OpenAI 提供的託管工具，

cues.en: You need to use the getResponsesClient like I'm doing here at the bottom on line 32. Okay.
cues.zh: 必須用這裡第 32 行的 GetResponsesClient，

cues.en: We did the same thing, actually, with the code interpreter as well.
cues.zh: Code Interpreter 也是同樣做法。

cues.en: You're going to do the asAIAgent, pass in the model for JPT5, for instance, and then we create our options, passing a name for it, give it a description.
cues.zh: 再呼叫 AsAIAgent，傳入模型，例如 GPT-5，建立選項，提供名稱和描述。

cues.en: The important part, of course, like in the code interpreter one, in the chat option give it a very strong instruction that it must use web search for current events and scores and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 和程式碼解譯器一樣，重要的是在 ChatOptions 加入明確指示，要求查詢目前事件、比分等資訊時，一定使用網路搜尋。

cues.en: So you are an AI assistant that helps people find information.
cues.zh: 例如：「你是協助人們尋找資訊的 AI 助理。」

cues.en: You must use the web search tool to look up any real-world events, scores, news, or facts.
cues.zh: 「所有真實世界事件、比分、新聞或事實，都必須使用網路搜尋工具查詢。」

cues.en: Never say you cannot search.
cues.zh: 「不要說你無法搜尋。」

cues.en: Always use your web search tool.
cues.zh: 「一律使用網路搜尋工具。」

cues.en: So this is based on a lot of recommendations from Microsoft as well to force the tool always, when you're asking about something recent, to always use the hosted.
cues.zh: 這也參考了微軟的一些建議，要求詢問近期資訊時，一定使用託管搜尋，

cues.en: So usually you will create the tools array and you will say hosted web search tool, and that's the only thing that you need.
cues.zh: 因此通常只要建立 Tools 陣列，放入 HostedWebSearchTool，就夠了。

cues.en: But I found it to be always useful to add your own functions, like we did before all the way at the bottom.
cues.zh: 不過，我發現再加入自己的函式通常很有幫助，就像最下面這個，

cues.en: I didn't have to create a class, just a static function that returns the date and time, UTC now, just to tell the system what day it is today.
cues.zh: 不必建立類別，只用靜態函式回傳 DateTime.UtcNow，告訴系統今天的日期，

cues.en: Just because when we ask a question, even with the hosted tools, it thinks that today was somewhere in 2024 or 2025, the date the model was last trained.
cues.zh: 因為即使有託管工具，模型有時仍以為今天是訓練時的 2024、2025 年某一天，

cues.en: So it's important sometimes to add that.
cues.zh: 所以有時補上目前時間很重要，

cues.en: Sometimes it works without it, depending on the model, but I always like to include it as well. All right?
cues.zh: 有些模型不加也能運作，但我習慣一併提供。

cues.en: All right, now we can actually go ahead and do the run async or run streaming async.
cues.zh: 接著就能呼叫 RunAsync 或 RunStreamingAsync，

cues.en: My question would be, what is the score between Liverpool and Brighton in the Premier League that was played on March 21, 2026?
cues.zh: 問題是：「2026 年 3 月 21 日，英超利物浦對布萊頓的比分是多少？」。

cues.en: Always include today's dates at the top as well.
cues.zh: 「也請在最上方顯示今天的日期。」

cues.en: So obviously, because GPT-5 was trained in 2025, it will not know about anything that happened on March 21, 2026.
cues.zh: 因為 GPT-5 的訓練資訊停在 2025 年，所以當然不會原本就知道 2026 年 3 月 21 日發生的事情，

cues.en: So it will be forced to use the hosted web search tool.
cues.zh: 因此必須使用託管網路搜尋工具。

cues.en: And based on my instruction, it must use it, and because I'm asking about scores and stuff like that, it should be able to go and get the web search tool invoked,
cues.zh: 而且指示明確要求，加上問的是比分，它應該會呼叫搜尋工具，

cues.en: and it will be able to get us that.
cues.zh: 替我們取得答案。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and give it a shot and see if it will work.
cues.zh: 實際試試，看看能否成功，

cues.en: So let's come in here. We'll say .NET run.
cues.zh: 執行 dotnet run，

cues.en: And let me make this a little bit bigger to see if the system will be able to come back with the correct answer using the Bing grounding automatically coming from Microsoft using the hosted web search tool.
cues.zh: 把畫面放大，看看系統能否透過微軟提供的 Bing Grounding 與 HostedWebSearchTool，自動取得正確答案。

cues.en: And after about 33 seconds, it came back and said, again, I told it to put the current date, April 11, 2026, but Brighton and Liverpool was 2-1,
cues.zh: 大約 33 秒後，答案回來，先依要求顯示目前日期 2026 年 4 月 11 日，再告訴我們布萊頓對利物浦是 2 比 1，

cues.en: and it actually even gave you a citation from the ESP.com.
cues.zh: 甚至附上 ESPN 網站的引用，

cues.en: Sometimes it comes from ESP from the UK, from the American ESPN, and so on.
cues.zh: 有時來源是英國體育網站，有時是美國 ESPN 等等，

cues.en: It will tell you exactly where to go get more information about the game and so on.
cues.zh: 會告訴你去哪裡查看更多比賽資訊。

cues.en: But look how much tokens it actually used because it had to ask the web search from Bing grounding.
cues.zh: 但看看 Token 用量，因為得透過 Bing Grounding 搜尋，

cues.en: So it's almost 20,000 tokens on the input that ended up being passed to the LLM.
cues.zh: 最後送進 LLM 的輸入，將近兩萬個 Token，

cues.en: So you're actually paying a significant amount of money.
cues.zh: 所以會產生相當一筆費用，

cues.en: Well, it's not really a lot because, remember, it's $1.25 for every million.
cues.zh: 當然也沒有非常多，因為記得，每百萬輸入是 1.25 美元，

cues.en: So it's a few pennies here that would be paid.
cues.zh: 這次其實只是幾美分。

cues.en: But can you imagine having 10,000 people asking that question in your organization?
cues.zh: 但如果組織有一萬個人都問這個問題呢？

cues.en: But, okay, somebody actually asked that question before, and this has been cached on the provider side.
cues.zh: 不過，有人先前問過，而供應商已經快取相關內容，

cues.en: So that means in the GPT-5.
cues.zh: 也就是 GPT-5 這一端，

cues.en: So 3712 out of these have been cached, which will end up paying 10% of the input token.
cues.zh: 其中 3,712 個 Token 已快取，只要付一般輸入 Token 的 10%，

cues.en: So it's definitely a good deal there.
cues.zh: 所以這部分很划算。

cues.en: It came in about 1,700 different tokens coming back.
cues.zh: 回傳的輸出大約有 1,700 個 Token，

cues.en: The total was 21,000, and it took 33 seconds to do this entire job. All right?
cues.zh: 總數是 21,000，整體花了 33 秒，

cues.en: So this is how we can use the second hosted one, which is the web search tool.
cues.zh: 以上就是第二種託管工具，也就是網路搜尋的用法。

cues.en: And hopefully you liked that, and I'll see you again in the next video. Thank you.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡，我們下段影片見，謝謝。
